newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha softens on poor prompt buying.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha softens on poor prompt buying.

text.p: NWE naphtha was softer on Tuesday as crude oil futures weakened and amid continued signs of poor demand for product in the prompt period, traders said.
June swaps were talked 50 cents weaker at around $187 a tonne with July still in contango to June by around $1.25.
While strength in gasoline was continuing to buoy prices for n+a napththa, petrochemical buyers said requirements in early June were limited.
